description: This file defines the TLSStat struct and functions to read TLS-related network statistics from /proc/net/tls_stat in a Linux environment, part of the procfs package.

methods.name: NewTLSStat
methods.description: Reads TLS network statistics from /proc/net/tls_stat using the default mount point.

methods.name: NewTLSStat (method)
methods.description: Reads TLS network statistics from the file system associated with the FS instance.
